h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Navi Mumbai

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Navi Mumbai

items.pText: Navi Mumbai was planned node by node, and almost every sector in Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Airoli and Kharghar has a garden or open space set aside for residents. Many of those spaces now need new play equipment, and the newer nodes need it for the first time. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai East, about 39 km away by road.

We have designed and built play equipment since 2002, with our own roto-moulding and fabrication units. For Navi Mumbai we send the equipment by road and install it with our own team. A housing society, school or builder deals with the manufacturer from the first drawing to the final bolt. You share the site size and photos, and we send back a layout with the safe play area marked.

richText.heading: Sector gardens and society open spaces

c: A typical Navi Mumbai society has a recreation ground between buildings, often with an old slide and a swing frame that have rusted at the base. Replacing them is a good time to rethink the layout. One combined play station in the centre, with spring riders for toddlers on one side, uses the same space far better than scattered single pieces.
For societies that want a theme children will remember, our
Robo Romp
robot-themed stations pack slides and climbers into a compact footprint. Gardens shared by the whole sector need sturdier, simpler pieces that can take crowds every evening.

richText.heading: Creek air, hill runoff and the monsoon

c: Much of Navi Mumbai sits between the Thane creek and the Parsik hills. Sites near the creek get damp, salty air, and those near the hills see heavy runoff in the monsoon from June to September. Both conditions are hard on bare steel.

Our posts are galvanised and our slides and panels are roto-moulded plastic, which does not rust. Place the play area on ground that drains towards the storm water line, not towards the building. After the rains, ask your housekeeping staff to tighten bolts and clear silt from under the spring riders.

richText.heading: New towers in Kharghar, Ulwe and beyond

c: Builders in the newer nodes often place the children's area on a podium above parking. We use the self-standing method there, so the waterproofing on the slab is not disturbed, and lay rubber flooring over the podium surface. On natural ground we grout the posts into concrete.
If your project lies towards the Panvel side, our
Panvel page
covers that area. A layout drawing early in the design stage lets your architect fix drainage points and lighting around the play area before the podium is finished.

richText.heading: A short drive from our factory

c: Being this close helps when a site has a narrow gate or a fixed handover date. Our installation crew can plan around your other contractors, and spare parts have only a short way to travel. Across the creek we have installed play equipment for
Raymond in Thane
Many societies here also want equipment for adults who use the garden for morning walks. Our
outdoor gym equipment in Navi Mumbai
page explains what fits beside a play area.

items.q: Can you replace old playground equipment in our Navi Mumbai society?
items.a: Yes. Send us photos of the existing equipment and the ground, with rough measurements. We suggest new pieces that fit the same space and send a layout with the safe play area marked. If you want, we remove the old frames when we install the new ones.

items.q: Is your equipment safe to install on a podium slab?
items.a: We use the self-standing method on podiums, which does not need deep holes in the slab. Rubber flooring over the podium cushions falls. Share the podium details with us early so your architect can confirm the load and drainage.

items.q: How do you deal with the salty air near the creek?
items.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist rust far better than painted mild steel. Rinse the equipment with fresh water now and then, keep the drains clear and follow the maintenance steps we hand over after installation.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Navi Mumbai?
items.a: Our own installation team, working from our factory in Vasai East, about 39 km away. We fix the posts by grouting or the self-standing method, depending on the ground, and walk your staff through basic care at handover.
